about: Memento on the Retroid Pocket Nova: the same web build in the system WebView 109 (the app's engine, a side-by-side debug build com.rnaud.moebius.perf) and in Chrome 154; Handheld preset; scripts/bench/android-engines.mjs

modes.fixed: dynamic resolution off, render scale 0.75 on both (equal pixels)

method.missed: share of 60 Hz refreshes missed: each frame interval counts round(interval / 16.7) refreshes, all but one missed
method.js: median time of the animation-frame callbacks (the game's whole frame on the main thread)
method.gc: V8 GC pauses on the page's main thread (trace category disabled-by-default-v8.gc; steps under 0.3 ms apart merged)
